item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"The example creates a temporary `custom_module.py` that defines a custom `dspy.Module`, temporarily adds that directory to `sys.path`, imports the module, instantiates it, and saves the program with `save_program=True`.","span_ids":["s4"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"The first round saves the whole program without `modules_to_serialize`, then removes `custom_module` from `sys.modules` and removes the temp directory from `sys.path`, and shows that `dspy.load(..., allow_pickle=True)` fails specifically with `ModuleNotFoundError`.","span_ids":["s3","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The second round saves with `save(..., save_program=True, modules_to_serialize=[custom_module])`, reflecting DSPy’s by-value path where `BaseModule.save` registers those modules with `cloudpickle.register_pickle_by_value` instead of relying on import-by-reference resolution.","span_ids":["s1","s2","s6"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"After re-saving with `modules_to_serialize`, the example again removes the original import path/module and proves `dspy.load(..., allow_pickle=True)` now succeeds, preserving observable program architecture state such as the nested predictor signature.","span_ids":["s3","s6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/primitives/base_module.py","start_line":168,"end_line":181},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/primitives/base_module.py","start_line":213,"end_line":218},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/utils/saving.py","start_line":27,"end_line":61},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":135,"end_line":156},{"span_id":"s5","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":157,"end_line":165},{"span_id":"s6","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":167,"end_line":183}]}
